audit_items.proof_trace: All three state-machine branches revert on violation. (1) `invest()` after `hasEnded`: explicit `whenRaiseNotEnded` guard reverts. (2) `claimTokenAllocation()` before `tokensSupplied`: `LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale` has an explicit `whenTokensSupplied` guard; for the three `LegionAbstractSale` subclasses the call reverts implicitly — for any non-zero allocation the `safeTransfer` fails (no tokens in contract), and for zero allocations the immutable merkle root (enforced by `_verifyCanPublishSaleResults` which blocks second publication) means no future claim can be lost. (3) `cancel()` after supply: `_verifyCanSupplyTokens` requires `totalTokensAllocated != 0`, and both the abstract `cancel()` (`whenSaleResultsNotPublished`) and the overrides in `PreLiquidApprovedSale`/`OpenApplicationSale` (`whenTokensNotSupplied`) prevent cancellation once tokens are supplied.
